name: MoCapAct
summary: 面向仿真人形控制的动作捕捉到动作数据集，发布可跟踪 CMU MoCap 片段的专家策略及其带噪声 rollout，包含本体观测、动作和奖励。
summaryEn: A simulated humanoid-control dataset that releases expert policies tracking CMU MoCap clips and noisy rollouts with proprioceptive observations, actions, and rewards.
scale: Small 46 GB and large 559 GB HDF5 rollout datasets over 2,589 MoCap snippets
scaleZh: 覆盖 2,589 个动作捕捉片段，提供 46 GB 小版和 559 GB 大版 HDF5 rollout 数据
organizations: Microsoft Research and Georgia Institute of Technology
organizationsZh: Microsoft Research 与佐治亚理工学院
license: Dataset terms require verification; code is available from the official repository
licenseZh: 数据使用条款需进一步核查；官方仓库提供代码
access: Official project page, GitHub code, and Hugging Face dataset collection available
accessZh: 官方项目页、GitHub 代码和 Hugging Face 数据集合可用
verdict: 带动作的仿真人形动作捕捉 rollout
verdictEn: Humanoid motion-capture rollouts with executable actions
wmNote: 它把纯运动捕捉转化为可执行的观测-动作-奖励序列，直接支持人形动力学建模、动作补全和层级策略学习。
wmNoteEn: It turns kinematic MoCap clips into executable observation-action-reward sequences, directly supporting humanoid dynamics modeling, motion completion, and hierarchical policy learning.
